Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:


Yet another reason why the new WW homepage is extra-useless for V:tES.
It's really absurd that their 'VTES Home Page' has more (and more
prominent) news articles about Requiem, Exalted and dice than it does
about the product line the page is supposedly the official home page
for.

The old site may have had some functional and/or asthetic problems, but
at least all of the information about the game was readily findable,
did not require much in the way of guesswork, and generally free of
content completely unrelated to the game.

LSJ, could you let us know to whom comments (or complaints) about the
website should be directed to at WW? Might be worth considering sending
some sort of mass petition asking them to make the V:tES page more
effective for their player base.

For instance, it'd be nice if the new pages contained links to the
content of the old pages without having to actually GO to the old home
page; there's more than a few previously-accessible (and still
desirable) pages that apparently cannot be accessed any other way.
-John Flournoy
